description: P3: screen share over WebRTC (PeerLink perfect negotiation, ShareBroadcaster/Viewer, server share:* and targeted rtc:signal relay, endShare on all triggers). Depends on FEAT-002.
steps: Do plan.md tasks P3-1 through P3-4 in order (design.md section 9 is the contract).
Include createOffer/createAnswer fallback in PeerLink (review note 5).
Smoke must assert old host socket gets media:state with media null after host:transfer (review note 2).
acceptance_criteria: Fake-RTCPeerConnection tests pass: retry link identity, stale linkId ignored, store-driven teardown
Smoke: rtc:signal reaches only its target; viewer-to-viewer dropped; teardown broadcasts on transfer and sharer socket close
verification: npm run typecheck; npm run lint; npm test; npm run build
npm --prefix signaling-server test; npm --prefix signaling-server run build
background server + npm --prefix signaling-server run smoke
findings: P3 done. Server: share:start (screen, plus file-stream conversion per design 6)/share:stop, targeted rtc:signal relay (active session, sharer<->viewer only, drops silent), shared hasFile reset helper. Client: src/lib/webrtc (iceConfig, support, capture, PeerLink with createOffer/createAnswer fallback and ICE restart, ShareBroadcaster store-driven teardown, ShareViewer with fresh linkId per viewer-ready), RoomController.share + notifier, ScreenSharePanel/ScreenView/LiveBadge, Screen tab in SourceSelector, link state on People tab. Gate: typecheck, lint, root tests 180 pass, build ok, server tests 84 pass, server build ok, smoke 48/48 incl. review note 2 (old host gets media:state media:null after host:transfer). Not verified: real browser/cross-network WebRTC, bitrate cap, TURN. Note: shell env had PORT=8791 so server and smoke used 8791.
